fusions.name: Skillet Swing
fusions.desc: A heavy swing that deals 32 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scalding Lid
fusions.desc: A shoving strike that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and knocks it back 2 tiles. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dutch Oven
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Cold Larder
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, every heal reaching you is worth 50% more for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. Your armour rises by 8%.
